context: A police officer briefs on compliance
purpose: Teach: 文体/電動/見送り/例文/厚み/大きめ/学費/利上げ

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 公的文書の文体、統一、お願いします。
lines.en: I'd appreciate it if you could standardize the language in the public documents.
lines.style: Professional and measured. Direct request without urgency. Even pace, steady gaze. The tone of someone accustomed to coordination meetings.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察車両、電動化が進んでいると伺いました。
lines.en: Of course. I understand the police vehicles are being electrified progressively.
lines.style: Attentive and cooperative. Slight nod of acknowledgment on the opening. Respectful cadence. Shows he's been listening and engaged with the brief.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 共同訓練、見送りも、検討中です。
lines.en: Joint training exercises—we're still reviewing whether to proceed with those.
lines.style: Formal, administrative tone. Pause before the dash to let the hesitation land. Measured delivery. No rush toward decision.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。マニュアルの例文、警察庁にも提供します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll provide the manual examples to the National Police Agency as well.
lines.style: Efficient and clear. Slight emphasis on 'as well' to confirm the scope of the task. Confident, forward-looking tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察庁の冊子、厚み出して、配布しています。
lines.en: The NPA's handbooks are being printed thicker now and distributed widely.
lines.style: Factual update delivered with quiet satisfaction. Even tempo. Slight emphasis on 'thicker' to underscore the tangible improvement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察車両、大きめサイズで、訓練しました。
lines.en: Right. We've already conducted training with the larger police vehicle models.
lines.style: Affirming completion with understated confidence. Brisk but not rushed. Shows readiness to move forward.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察学校の学費、無料化されています。
lines.en: Police academy tuition has been made free now.
lines.style: Straightforward statement of policy. Neutral delivery—no celebration, just fact. Pace remains steady and professional.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経済政策、利上げの影響、共有します。
lines.en: Understood. I'll share the economic policy impacts from the recent interest rate increase.
lines.style: Closing statement with slight upward inflection. Confirming the handoff. Professional but not stiff—the tone of wrapping up a productive meeting.
